title: Blood Collection for COM/BSBS
official: Blood Collection for Use with Translational, Biomedical Research At UCF College of Medicine and Burnett School of Biomedical Sciences
summary: The objective of this biospecimen collection protocol is the acquisition of blood from adult volunteers. These biospecimens will be transferred to the College of Medicine (COM)/Burnett School of Biomedical Sciences (BSBS) research scientists and their research teams for testing according to their separate IRB-approved/exempted protocols. These separate IRBapproved protocols cannot be for genetic testing.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female adults
* 18 years old or older
* weigh over 110 pounds
* able to provide informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnant/suspect to be pregnant
* prisoners
* have donated blood anywhere in the preceding 16 weeks
